item.title: In Memory of Professor Sir David Metcalf CBE
item.content:encoded:
Steve Machin, LSE

Maria Koumenta, Queen Mary University of London

Alex Bryson, UCL

This special issue honours the legacy of Professor Sir David Metcalf, a prominent labour economist and industrial relations scholar at the LSE who shaped the field over four decades. The journal seeks theoretically grounded empirical research that embodies his scholarly approach to understanding economic and policy dimensions of industrial relations.

The call welcomes contributions addressing core labour economics topics including union activity, wage structures, workplace disputes, firm performance, minimum wage policies, worker mobility, immigration effects, and labour market governance. The initiative combines a conference and subsequent journal publication, reflecting Metcalf's commitment to rigorous, policy-relevant research.

Appel publié par British Journal of Industrial Relations. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Trade unions
  • Pay and payment systems
  • Conflict and dispute resolution
  • Productivity and firm performance
  • Low pay and minimum wages
  • Labour market transitions
  • Immigration
  • Labour market regulation and enforcement
